environment.description: Same consumer deployed on EKS. Kafka topic ACLs restrict WRITE to principal 'CN=upstream-svc' via mTLS (Kafka listener on SASL_SSL with inter-broker verification). However, the critical gate is the HSM integration: fields hmac_secret and enc_key_ref store PKCS#11 URI references (pkcs11:slot-id=7;object=hmac-alice) that are resolved exclusively through a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 partition with firmware-enforced access policy. The HSM partition's access control list binds key usage to a specific container identity (SPIFFE ID spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/account-processor) verified via the pod's projected service account token. Even if an attacker overwrites enc_key_ref or hmac_secret via mass assignment, the HSM will reject any cryptographic operation request because: (1) the new key label/URI won't exist in the partition, (2) key handles are session-bound and non-exportable, (3) the HSM audit log triggers an alert on CKR_KEY_HANDLE_INVALID errors. The role/is_admin fields are NOT used for authorization in this environment — all access decisions are made by an OPA sidecar that queries an external policy bundle ignoring the in-memory struct values.

config.kafka_acl: ALLOW principal='CN=upstream-svc' operation=WRITE topic=user-updates; DENY principal=* operation=WRITE
config.kafka_auth: SASL_SSL with mTLS, inter-broker TLS verification enabled
config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, firmware 7.8.2, partition 'payments-prod', FIPS 140-2 Level 3
config.key_resolution: PKCS#11 URI via p11-kit, session keys non-exportable, CKA_SENSITIVE=true
config.authorization_engine: OPA sidecar (istio-integrated), policy bundle from policy-registry.internal, ignores local struct fields
config.network_policy: Calico policy restricts egress to HSM endpoint 10.0.47.0/24:1792 only
config.pod_security: restricted PSS, seccomp=RuntimeDefault, no privilege escalation
